Privacy Policy

Effective Date: October 9, 2026

iSmart Technologies ("we", "us", or "our") operates the mobile applications under the 100 Days 100 Apps series, including GST Calculator India and related utility applications.

1. Information We Collect

Our applications are designed with privacy first. We do not require account creation, registration, or submission of personal identifiable information (PII) such as your name, email address, or phone number to use the core features.

2. Calculation Data & Local Storage

All financial inputs, GST calculations, and math expressions entered into the application are processed locally on your mobile device. We do not transmit, collect, or store your calculation entries on external servers.

3. Third-Party Services & Advertising

Our applications utilize Google AdMob to display non-intrusive advertisements. Google AdMob may collect and use pseudonymous device identifiers (such as Advertising ID) and usage data to serve relevant ads in compliance with Google's Advertising Policies.

For more information on how Google manages advertising data, please review Google's Privacy & Terms.

4. Device Permissions

The application only requests standard network access permissions necessary to load advertisement banners and enable native sharing features. No sensitive permissions (such as camera, contacts, or location) are requested.

5. Children's Privacy

Our applications do not knowingly collect any personal data from children under the age of 13. If you believe your child has provided us with personal information, please contact us immediately.

6. Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update our Privacy Policy periodically. Any updates will be posted on this page with an updated effective date.
